title: Fix parsing of pseudo-elements and pseudo-classes after ::details-content
author: rorshopping
summary: Models element-backed pseudo-elements (`::details-content`, `::picker()`) in the forked selectors parser, following upstream servo/stylo: pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements may follow them, `::marker` may follow `::before/::after`, and they may follow `::part()`. Fixes a strict-mode hard error on CSS that all major browsers accept.
evidence: Master (574eee2): `::details-content::before{color:red}` fails with SelectorError(InvalidState) (the CLI panics on it). yisibl (member) review 2026-09-11 asked for `::details-content::before::marker` and `::part(foo)::details-content::before` and a comprehensive treatment; the author reworked it on 2026-09-16 to mirror upstream stylo and the Chromium CL, with a deliberate deviation (`::before::marker::marker` rejected). Not yet re-reviewed. Out of scope for the PR: it also adds `-C link-arg=--allow-undefined` to .cargo/config.toml to fix the wasm build on rustc >= 1.96 (should probably be split out or landed on master separately) and an unrelated rustfmt hunk. Check the HAS_PSEUDO flag change against the `:is()` lowering in rules/mod.rs.
